allocation_accounting.scope: Dispatcher wall time includes initialization,measurement and retirement. Multiply by resident device count,not by kernel busy. It excludes pair-lock waiting and burner execution. Natural-reference shard bounds use command and terminal status timestamps. They do not include every shutdown tail or custom preflight. This is partial resource accounting,not exclusive GPU compute time or billing.

scope: Check printed Worker configuration and every logged actual query batch in completed starts. B8192/S1024 remains an upper bound,not actual batch geometry. Padded queries are reported separately. A budget pass does not qualify teacher numerics,task quality,observer overhead or serving safety. Failed and unfinished runs remain separate. Repeat after GPU closeout for the final denominator.
